mapper.sql: username, device_id, public_key, algorithm, key_version, fingerprint, supports_padding, supports_recall_token, crt_time, upd_time
mapper.select:
select
from t_user_key where username = #{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and device_id = 'default'

select k.username, k.device_id, k.public_key, k.algorithm, k.key_version, k.fingerprint, k.supports_padding, k.supports_recall_token, k.crt_time, k.upd_time from t_user_key k join t_device d on d.username = k.username and d.device_id = k.device_id and d.revoked = 0 where k.username = #{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by d.last_seen desc
mapper.insert: insert into t_user_key (username, device_id, public_key, algorithm, key_version, fingerprint, supports_padding, supports_recall_token, crt_time, upd_time) values (#{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{publicKey,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{algorithm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{version,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{fingerprint,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ifnull(#{supportsPadding,jdbcType=TINYINT}, 0), ifnull(#{supportsRecallToken,jdbcType=TINYINT}, 0), #{crtTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) on duplicate key update public_key = values(public_key), algorithm = values(algorithm), key_version = values(key_version), fingerprint = values(fingerprint), supports_padding = values(supports_padding), supports_recall_token = values(supports_recall_token), upd_time = values(upd_time)
